sources.scope: Explicit original raster through actual C API; no SDK host qualification.

decisions: Explicit absolute module/model paths and exact native-version/export/model binding replace any default engine/model discovery.
Fresh process lifetime retains native module/TLS safely while per-job API/monitor/UTF8/TSV/gray ownership is released before response.
Headerless C-API TSV is normalized explicitly; raster geometry and raw engine order/confidence remain distinct from semantic order, language accuracy or PDF coordinates.
Native process reservations, original host isolation and supervised cancellation/deadlines remain mandatory; unavailable Landlock blocks execution rather than selecting fallback.
